transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I just... I don't know. I don't really feel like myself anymore, I guess. I used to do things. Hike, coach, play guitar... but I stopped. I don't call anyone back. Most days I just sit in my rental for hours. I know there's stuff I should be doing, but... I just can't make myself start.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
Not really. I don't... I wouldn't say I'm sad. Just... I don't know. I don't really feel much of anything.
Do you still enjoy things when you actually do them?

Not really. Um... like I said, I just don't feel like myself. Even if I were to pick up the guitar or something, it's just... I don't get anything out of it anymore. So I just... go back to sitting in my place.
Did this start after a major stress or life change?
I guess. Um... it's been about a year and two months. That's when I... moved into this smaller rental. After my divorce. Things just sort of... unraveled since then.
Have you felt this way on most days for at least two years?
No. Um... like I said, it's just been since the move. So... a little over a year. Not two.
Has this made it hard for you to keep up with your work or daily responsibilities?

Yeah. Um... I'm actually suspended right now. From my job in protective services. Just... something happened on a routine patrol. They said I scared the staff and some bystanders, so... they sent me home. 

And I just... I don't really do the other things I used to do, either. Coaching, volunteering... I've just kind of pulled away from the people who used to count on me.
Before this started after your divorce, had you ever had another period like this in your life?
No. Um... not that I remember. Just... since the divorce.
Have you noticed a big change in your sleep?
No. Um... not really. I sleep fine, I guess. Just... about the same.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?
No. Um... not really. My energy is fine, I guess. I don't feel... unusually tired or anything. Just normal.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, even when there isn’t an immediate problem to deal with?
No. Um... not really. I don't... worry that much, I suppose. Just... normal stuff. Nothing special.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of killing yourself?
No. I don't... I don't have thoughts like that. No. I'm fine.
Do you feel your reaction to the divorce has been stronger than most people would have in the same situation?
No. I don't... I don't think so. It's just a divorce. I handled it fine, I guess. Just... like anyone else would.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
Not really. I can focus... fine. When I need to. It's not a problem.
Have you been feeling worthless or like you’ve let people down?
No. I haven't... I haven't felt like that. I'm just... doing my job. Doing what I'm supposed to do.
On most days since this began, have you felt depressed or down?
No. I'm not... I wouldn't say I'm depressed. I just... wake up and do my shifts. I don't really feel down.
Have other people noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?
No. Nobody's... nobody has said anything like that to me. I just work at my normal pace.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite?
No. I haven't noticed anything like that. I just... eat what I usually eat.
Have you had a noticeable change in your weight?
No. I don't really... weigh myself. But my uniform still fits the same. So, no.
Do you feel like you’ve lost your motivation to do things?

I guess you could say that. I just... I don't feel much like myself lately. I used to do things. Hike, coach... play my guitar. But I stopped. I don't really call anyone back anymore either. Some days I just sit in my rental for hours. I know I should do things, but... I just can't seem to make myself start.
Since this started, have you been feeling sad or down most days?
No. I wouldn't say sad. I don't really... I don't feel down. I just don't feel much of anything, really.
